changelog.name: Now Bar Color 2.0.0
changelog.body:
## Now Bar Color v2.0.0 (`versionCode 5`)

**Native "1 APK + Isolated Adapters" architecture for Samsung One UI 8.0, 8.5, and 9.0+ (Lock Screen & AOD) — no separate `AOD_Service.apk` or `NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip` required.**

> [!NOTE]
> **Early-Stage Project Notice & Tested Custom ROM / Port Builds**
> - This project is still **very new and under active development**, so visual or behavioral glitches may still occur on untested Samsung builds.
> - **v2.0.0 direct testing so far** was conducted on Custom ROM / Port firmwares *(ports bundle `AOD_Service` APKs from newer flagships; untested factory stock ROMs may behave differently)*:
>   - **Galaxy S23 Ultra (Custom ROM / Port `SM-S938B`)** — One UI 9.0 / Android 17 · `AOD_Service` `8.9.65.90` (`896590000`) & `8.9.67.3` (`896703000`)
>   - **Galaxy S20 FE (`SM-G780G`, Custom ROM / Port)** — One UI 8.5 / Android 16 · `AOD_Service` `8.9.32.89` (`893289000`)
>   - **Galaxy S22 Ultra (Custom ROM / Port `SM-S901E`)** — One UI 8.0 / Android 16 · `AOD_Service` `8.9.15.39` (`891539000`)
> - Found a bug or `MISSING`/`AMBIGUOUS` diagnostics? Message **[@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)** on Telegram *(attach **Copy Diagnostics** from the app)* or open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/issues).

---

### What's New in v2.0.0

- **Universal Adaptive Engine (DexKit + Isolated Adapters):**
  - `AodScanner` inspects your installed `com.samsung.android.app.aodservice` APK on-device using **DexKit**, caches a schema-`v8` `HookMap` via `NowBarConfigProvider`, and dispatches through `NowBarAdapterFactory` (`OneUi80Adapter`, `OneUi85Adapter`, `OneUi9Adapter`).
  - **One UI 8.5 Fix (`OneUi85Adapter`):** Keeps non-media capsule controls and text visible in foreground/resting state instead of vanishing after drag/release.
  - **One UI 8.0 Fix (`OneUi80Adapter`):** Stabilizes custom capsule colors across expand/collapse and wake/unlock cycles.
- **Calibrated One UI 8.5 Glass Color Blur (`OneUiBlurSpec`):**
  - Clean `16px–100px` blur radius (default `~60%` / `~65px`), dedicated **Tint Opacity** slider (`25%–85%`, default `~60%`), saturated `SemBlurInfo` ColorCurve rendering, and a subtle `~1dp` diagonal specular glass rim + surface sheen mirrored in `CapsulePreviewStage`.
- **Diagnostics & Refinements:**
  - In-app **Compatibility Diagnostics** showing active adapter, DexKit `HookMap` slot statuses, **Re-scan**, and one-tap **Copy Diagnostics**.

---

### Installation
1. Download and install **`NowBarColor.apk`** below (or update directly from **LSPosed / Vector Repository** — shares the exact signing key with `v1.3.0`).
2. Enable **Now Bar Color** in LSPosed/Vector with **System UI** (`com.android.systemui`) and **Always On Display** (`com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`) scoped.
3. Open **Now Bar Color** once so DexKit caches the `HookMap`, then **reboot** *(recommended)* or run `su -c "pkill -f com.android.systemui; pkill -f com.samsung.android.app.aodservice"`. *(If Always On Display updates via Galaxy Store later, open the app / tap **Re-scan** and restart System UI & AOD.)*

### Upgrading from v1.x (Migration)
- **One UI 8.0 / 8.5 Suite users (`v1.2` / `v1.3`):** Remove/disable **`NowBar_LockScreen_Suite`** and **`LockScreenFix_OU9`** in **KernelSU / Magisk / APatch Manager** and reboot so unnecessary `priv-app` mounts are removed.
- **One UI 9.0+ manual `AOD_Service.apk` users:** Optionally restore your factory AOD via `su -c "pm uninstall-system-updates com.samsung.android.app.aodservice"`, open **Now Bar Color** to re-scan, and reboot.

### Licensing
- Module source code is **MIT** licensed; prebuilt native/runtime libraries (`libdexkit.so` under **LGPL-3.0**, plus `dexkit.jar`, `flatbuffers-java`, `kotlin-stdlib` under **Apache-2.0**) are attributed with license texts and upstream sources in [`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md).

changelog.name: Now Bar Color 1.3.0
changelog.body:
> [!WARNING]
> **Legacy Release (`v1.3.0`) — Superseded by [`v2.0.0`](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/tag/5-2.0.0)**
>
> Starting with **`v2.0.0`**, Now Bar Color runs **natively** on stock One UI **8.0, 8.5, and 9.0+** via on-device DexKit scanning (**single APK only**).
> **Do NOT flash `NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip` or replace `AOD_Service.apk` on One UI 8.0 / 8.5 / 9.0+ if you install `v2.0.0+`.** These `v1.3.0` files are preserved strictly as a legacy archive.

---

## 🚨🔴 IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY WARNING (READ BEFORE INSTALLING) 🔴🚨

🚨 **CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE & `AOD_Service` BUILD REQUIREMENT — ONE UI 8.0 / 8.5 vs. ONE UI 9.0+** 🚨

- ⚠️ **Having One UI 9 does NOT guarantee immediate compatibility:** Samsung's **`AOD_Service` (`com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`)** changes drastically depending on each device's firmware branch and model.
- 🔴 **Mandatory Base `AOD_Service` Build (`896548000`):** It is **strictly mandatory** to run the exact same base build of `AOD_Service` used to develop this module—extracted from the **Galaxy S26 FE**, build **`896548000`** (`v8.9.65.48`). Any other `AOD_Service` variant or branch will cause graphical glitches in the capsule or prevent the module from working entirely.
- 🔴 **One UI 8.0 & One UI 8.5 Users (INSTALL THE FULL SUITE):** Users on One UI 8.0 and 8.5 **MUST** install the complete All-in-One Root Module Suite (**`NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip`**) via **KernelSU, Magisk, or APatch**:
  - 👉 **Direct Download (One UI 8.0 / 8.5 Suite):** [**Download NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip (v1.3.0)**](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/4-1.3.0/NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip)
  - **Automatic LSPosed Activation:** Includes the S26 FE `AOD_Service` (`896548000`), `DressRoom`, `GalleryWidget`, `SamsungGallery`, `LockStar` 9.0.00.5, the latest `LockScreenFix_OU9` (v2.1.7), and `NowBarColor` v1.3.0. **Upon flashing the Suite and rebooting, both LSPosed modules (`NowBarColor` and `LockScreenFix_OU9`) and their target scopes are activated automatically via SQLite—no manual activation in LSPosed Manager is needed!**
- 🔴 **One UI 9.0+ Users (INSTALL THE STANDALONE `AOD_Service.apk`):** Users on the latest system version (One UI 9.0+) do **NOT** need the full Suite ZIP, but **MUST** install the standalone **`AOD_Service.apk`** (extracted from the **Galaxy S26 FE**, build **`896548000`**) provided in this release alongside **`NowBarColor.apk`**:
  - 👉 **Direct Download (`AOD_Service.apk` — S26 FE Build `896548000`):** [**Download AOD_Service.apk (896548000)**](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/4-1.3.0/AOD_Service.apk)
  - 💡 **KernelSU Cross-Branch Installation Tip:** If `AOD_Service.apk` fails to install as an update across different Samsung firmware branches, disable the official release verification first by running:
    ```bash
    su -c "/data/adb/ksu/bin/resetprop -n ro.build.official.release false"
    ```
    Then install `AOD_Service.apk` and `NowBarColor.apk`.

---

### What's New in v1.3.0 (`versionCode 4`)

- **Fixed Media Card Collapse Transition (Ghost Island Elimination):** Resolved a visual artifact where collapsing the expanded Music/Media card back into the Now Bar capsule left a temporary full-size rectangular background behind the shrinking card during the 150ms collapse transition.
- **Fixed Individual Capsule Category Titles & Descriptions:** Restored localized titles and descriptions across English, Spanish, and Portuguese for *Clock & Timer*, *Sports, Maps & Health*, and *Other Live Activities*.
- **Adaptive Compact UI Layout for Low DPI & Large Font Scales:** Added responsive layout scaling in the companion app and live preview capsule so text and gradient controls never wrap vertically on compact widths or high font zoom levels.
- **Updated All-in-One Suite (`NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip`):** Integrated `NowBarColor` v1.3.0 and the latest `LockScreenFix_OU9` (v2.1.7) build, plus standalone `AOD_Service.apk` (S26 FE build `896548000`) for One UI 9.0+ users.

---

### Community & Support
- **Telegram:** [@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)
- **Source Code & Full Tutorial:** [https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color)

changelog.name: Now Bar Color 1.1.0
changelog.body:
Now Bar Color v1.1.0 (versionCode 2)

What's New:
- Added trilingual localization support: English, Spanish, and Portuguese with an in-app language switcher.
- Performance and rendering optimizations:
  - Reusable CapsuleGradient to monitor and repair internal gradient mutations upon collapsing/expanding media cards.
  - High-performance ReflectionCache for SystemUI and FaceWidget classes to eliminate repeated reflection overhead.
  - Deduplicated drawables and paints across HSV color pickers and media previews.
  - Asynchronous background configuration loading and unified layout styling pipeline.
- Frame-0 instant hot-creation support when adding new cards directly from the lock screen.
- Official LSPosed Module Repository compatibility.

readme:
# Now Bar Color **Customize the collapsed Now Bar capsule background natively on Samsung One UI 8.0, 8.5, and 9.0+ (Lock Screen & AOD)** [![One UI](https://img.shields.io/badge/One_UI-8.0_%7C_8.5_%7C_9.0+-0072DE?style=flat-square&logo=samsung&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases) [![Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framework-LSPosed_%7C_Vector-EC407A?style=flat-square)](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/io.github.tavataan.nowbarcolor) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v2.0.0-2EA043?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/latest) [![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/I18n-EN_%7C_ES_%7C_PT-8A2BE2?style=flat-square)](#features) [![License: MIT + Third-Party](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT_%7C_LGPL--3.0_%7C_Apache--2.0-F1E05A?style=flat-square)](#license--author)
--- ## Overview **Now Bar Color** is an adaptive Xposed/LSPosed module for rooted Samsung Galaxy devices running **One UI 8.0, 8.5, and One UI 9.0+**. Starting with **v2.0.0**, it ships as a **single universal APK with isolated version adapters** powered by on-device **DexKit** bytecode scanning—operating dynamically against your installed `SystemUI` and `AOD_Service` without requiring a separate `AOD_Service` APK or root Suite ZIP. It gives you full control over collapsed Lock Screen and Always On Display (AOD) Now Bar capsule backgrounds—solid colors, calibrated One UI 8.5-style glass **Color Blur**, smooth two-stop horizontal gradients, and wallpaper-adaptive palettes—while keeping album art, icons, action buttons, text legibility, and native animations intact. It also includes a native One UI companion app featuring an interactive live capsule preview stage, real-time animated audio waveforms, squircle vector badges with live color cutouts, per-category toggles, independent opacity and blur/tint sliders, built-in compatibility diagnostics, and **English, Spanish, and Portuguese** localization. > [!NOTE] > **Early-Stage Project Notice, Tested Devices & Active Updates** > > This project is still **very new and actively maintained**, so visual glitches or firmware-specific bugs can still occur on untested Galaxy models or `AOD_Service` builds. Future updates will continue expanding firmware coverage. > > **v2.0.0 has only been directly tested on the following Custom ROM / Port environments** *(ported firmwares often embed `AOD_Service` APKs from newer Galaxy flagships, so untested factory stock builds may vary even when DexKit resolves dynamically)*: > > | Device | Environment & One UI | Verified `AOD_Service` Build (`versionCode`) | Adapter | > | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | > | **Galaxy S23 Ultra** | **Custom ROM / Port (`SM-S938B`)** — One UI 9.0 (Android 17) | `8.9.65.90` (`896590000`) & `8.9.67.3` (`896703000`) | `OneUi9Adapter` | > | **Galaxy S20 FE (`SM-G780G`)** | **Custom ROM / Port** — One UI 8.5 (Android 16) | `8.9.32.89` (`893289000`) | `OneUi85Adapter` | > | **Galaxy S22 Ultra** | **Custom ROM / Port (`SM-S901E`)** — One UI 8.0 (Android 16) | `8.9.15.39` (`891539000`) | `OneUi80Adapter` | > > If you encounter missing controls, reverted colors, or unmapped diagnostics on another stock ROM or port, please reach out on Telegram **[@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)** (use **Copy Diagnostics** inside the app) or open an issue on GitHub! --- ## Screenshots & Examples Lock screen and AOD capsule collages showing custom solid colors, two-stop gradients, and translucent blurs across Now Brief, Music Media, Flashlight, and Samsung Health capsules *(captures from `v1.x`; updated screenshots highlighting the `v2.0.0` companion UI and specular blur edge will be added later)*:
| Media & Now Brief Gradients | Flashlight, Health & Media Blur | Red Gradient, Dark Pill & Translucent Blur | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | |
--- ## Compatibility & Downloads (`v2.0.0`) **v2.0.0 runs with a single universal APK (`NowBarColor.apk`)** across compatible **One UI 8.0, 8.5, and 9.0+** ROMs (`arm64-v8a`), both factory firmware and Custom ROM ports: - **No separate `AOD_Service` APK required:** `AodScanner` inspects your installed `com.samsung.android.app.aodservice` via **DexKit**, caches a per-build `HookMap`, and automatically selects the isolated adapter for your One UI generation (`OneUi80Adapter`, `OneUi85Adapter`, or `OneUi9Adapter`). - **No root Suite ZIP required or recommended for `v2.0.0+`:** Do **not** flash legacy `v1.x` root ZIPs over One UI 8.0 / 8.5 / 9.0+ setups—`v2.0.0` operates natively through LSPosed / Vector alone. *(Legacy `v1.3.0` artifacts remain archived strictly inside the [`4-1.3.0`](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/tag/4-1.3.0) release.)* | Channel / Target | File / Catalog Entry | Description | Link | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **GitHub Releases (`5-2.0.0`)** | `NowBarColor.apk` | Universal Adaptive Module APK (`v2.0.0`, `versionCode 5`) | [Download APK (v2.0.0)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/5-2.0.0/NowBarColor.apk) | | **LSPosed & Vector Repo** | `io.github.tavataan.nowbarcolor` | Official online repository listing & in-manager updates | [View in LSPosed / Vector Repo](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/io.github.tavataan.nowbarcolor) |
Upgrading from v1.x (Migration from NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip or replaced AOD_Service.apk)
If you previously installed **`v1.2.0`** or **`v1.3.0`**, remove the old system/port overrides before staying on `v2.0.0+` so your device no longer carries unnecessary `priv-app` mounts or outdated hooks: 1. **Update the module APK:** Install [`NowBarColor.apk` (`v2.0.0`)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/5-2.0.0/NowBarColor.apk) over `v1.3.0` (both releases share the same signing certificate). 2. **If you flashed `NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip` (One UI 8.0 / 8.5):** - Open **KernelSU**, **Magisk**, or **APatch Manager** → **Modules**. - Disable or remove **`NowBar_LockScreen_Suite`** and **`LockScreenFix_OU9`**. - Reboot your device cleanly. 3. **If you manually installed the `v1.x` standalone `AOD_Service.apk` on One UI 9.0+:** - *(Optional, to restore your ROM's factory `AOD_Service`)* run in a root shell: ```bash su -c "pm uninstall-system-updates com.samsung.android.app.aodservice" ``` - Open **Now Bar Color** once so DexKit scans your restored factory `AOD_Service` build, then reboot.
--- ## Installation Guide 1. Ensure **LSPosed** (or **Vector** / JingMatrix fork) is installed and active on your rooted Samsung Galaxy device running **One UI 8.0, 8.5, or 9.0+**. 2. Download and install [`NowBarColor.apk` (v2.0.0)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/5-2.0.0/NowBarColor.apk) from GitHub Releases or the **LSPosed / Vector Repository**. 3. Open **LSPosed Manager** (or **Vector Manager**), enable **Now Bar Color**, and ensure its recommended scopes are checked: - **`System UI`** (`com.android.systemui`) - **`Always On Display`** (`com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`) 4. Open **Now Bar Color** once so DexKit scans and caches the `HookMap` for your `AOD_Service` build, then **reboot your device** *(recommended)* or run the dual-process restart below: ```bash su -c "pkill -f com.android.systemui; pkill -f com.samsung.android.app.aodservice" ``` 5. *(Note on Galaxy Store updates)* If Samsung updates **Always On Display** (`AOD_Service`) later, open **Now Bar Color** (or tap **Re-scan** inside Diagnostics; `NowBarConfigProvider` also detects mismatched `versionCode` / timestamps on demand) and restart System UI / AOD or reboot. --- ## Troubleshooting - **App reports module inactive (`Module Active (LSPosed): false`):** Confirm **Now Bar Color** is toggled ON in LSPosed / Vector Manager, verify both **`com.android.systemui`** and **`com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`** are checked in module scopes, and perform a full reboot. - **Diagnostics shows `MISSING(...)` or `AMBIGUOUS(...)` slots:** Open the app's **Diagnostics** dialog and tap **Re-scan**. If slots remain unmapped (or show *Partial Compatibility*), tap **Copy Diagnostics** and send the full report to Telegram **[@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)** or GitHub Issues along with your device model and ROM details. - **Capsule colors disappear after a Samsung Always On Display update:** Cached `HookMap` entries are bound to the previous `AOD_Service` `versionCode` and `lastUpdateTime`. Open **Now Bar Color** (or press **Re-scan** in Diagnostics) so DexKit indexes the new APK, then run `su -c "pkill -f com.android.systemui; pkill -f com.samsung.android.app.aodservice"` or reboot. - **Glitches or duplicated cards after updating from `v1.x`:** Make sure legacy `NowBar_LockScreen_Suite` and `LockScreenFix_OU9` modules were disabled/uninstalled and rebooted (see **Upgrading from v1.x** above). --- ## Features ### Visual Finish Modes & Adaptive Palettes | Finish Modes | Adaptive Wallpaper Extraction | | :--- | :--- | | **Pure Solid Color:** Crisp, high-contrast solid capsule backgrounds with per-category opacity. | **Bottom Zone:** Samples the exact lower lock screen wallpaper region behind the Now Bar. | | **Two-Stop Horizontal Gradients:** Smooth custom or preset two-color gradients globally or per capsule. | **Monet Accent:** Pulls Samsung's dynamic Material You system accent palette. | | **One UI 8.5 Glass Color Blur:** Calibrated `16px–100px` frosted blur (default `~60%` / `~65px`), dedicated **Tint Opacity** slider (`25%–85%`, default `~60%`), saturated `SemBlurInfo` ColorCurve rendering, and a subtle `~1dp` diagonal specular glass rim + surface sheen mirrored in the live preview stage. | **Dominant Background:** Matches the primary lock screen wallpaper color tone. | ### Granular Per-Category Control with Dynamic Vector Badges Each of the **10 Now Bar capsule categories** includes a large One UI squircle badge with transparent vector cutouts dynamically backed by its active color or gradient, plus independent toggles, color overrides, and opacity sliders: | Category | Target Component / Scope | | :--- | :--- | | **1. Music & Media Playback** | `NowBarMediaCardView` | | **2. Clock, Timer & Stopwatch** | Standard & ongoing clock capsules | | **3. Voice Recorder & Audio Memos** | Active recording chips | | **4. Flashlight** | Quick toggle active capsule | | **5. Live Battery & Charging** | `NowBarBatteryCardView` | | **6. Now Brief / Galaxy AI Suggestions** | `NowBarBriefCardView` | | **7. Ongoing Phone Calls** | Active call status capsule | | **8. Modes & Routines** | Active Bixby/System modes | | **9. Sports, Maps & Samsung Health** | Navigation, live scores & workouts | | **10. Other Live Activities** | Interpreter, Smart View & third-party ongoing chips | ### Under-the-Hood Architecture & Companion App - **1 APK + Isolated One UI Adapters:** `AodScanner` uses native **DexKit** to resolve obfuscated `AOD_Service` / `FaceWidget` classes, methods, and fields on first run, persists a schema-versioned `HookMap` via `NowBarConfigProvider`, and dispatches cleanly through `NowBarAdapterFactory` (`OneUi80Adapter`, `OneUi85Adapter`, `OneUi9Adapter`). - **Zero-Lag Frame-0 Styling & Wake Stabilization:** Intercepts card creation inside `NowBarCardStackView`, suppresses Samsung's native `NowBarCardGradientView` chip overlay, keeps controls visible in One UI 8.5 foreground state, and preserves custom colors during One UI 8.0 expand/collapse and wake/unlock transitions. - **Native One UI Companion App:** Interactive `CapsulePreviewStage` replicating real wallpaper blur + glass sheen, animated `OneUIMediaCapsuleView` waveforms, `OneUIFloatingBar` navigation, `HsvColorPickerView`, built-in diagnostics export, and an **EN / ES / PT** language switcher. --- ## Building from Source The repository includes a self-contained Python build script (`build.py`) compatible with Linux, Android (**Termux**), and desktop environments. ### Build Requirements - **JDK 8+** (`javac`, `keytool`) - **Android SDK Platform `android-34+`** (`--android-jar` or `ANDROID_HOME` / `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`) - **Android SDK Build Tools `35.0.0+` recommended** *(required for `zipalign -P 16` 16 KB ELF page alignment of `libdexkit.so` on Android 15+/16+; `build.py` falls back automatically to `-p` 4 KB alignment on `34.0.0`)* ### Compile & Sign ```bash # 1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color.git cd OneUI-Now-Bar-Color # 2. Run host verification tests (optional) python3 tests/run_host_tests.py --android-jar # 3. Build and sign the APK (auto-generates build/debug.keystore if absent) python3 build.py ``` #### Keystore & Signing Reproducibility - **Default debug signing:** When `--keystore` is omitted, `build.py` automatically creates (if absent) and reuses a local keystore at `build/debug.keystore` (`--alias androiddebugkey`, default password `android`). - **Custom signing:** Supply your own keystore via flags and environment variables: ```bash export NOWBAR_STORE_PASS="your-store-password" export NOWBAR_KEY_PASS="your-key-password" python3 build.py --keystore /path/to/release.keystore --alias mykey ``` - **Repository hygiene:** `build/`, `*.keystore`, and `*.jks` are ignored in [`.gitignore`](.gitignore); **no private release keystore is stored in the Git repository**. The signed APK is output to: ```text build/NowBarColor.apk ``` --- ## Project Structure ```text ├── AndroidManifest.xml & build.py # Package manifest, provider, build & APK signing pipeline ├── meta_xposed/ & SCOPE & SUMMARY # Xposed/LSPosed & Vector catalog metadata ├── assets/ & res/ # xposed_init, preview art, vector icons & localization strings ├── src/.../nowbarcolor/ │ ├── MainActivity.java & ui/ # Companion UI, CapsulePreviewStage, FloatingBar & I18n │ ├── NowBarHook.java & adapters # Multi-layer Xposed hooks & OneUi80/85/9 isolated adapters │ ├── AodScanner & HookMap # On-device DexKit bytecode scanner, cache & ConfigProvider │ └── CapsuleStyle & BlurSpec # Solid, Gradient & calibrated 16–100px Color Blur pipeline ├── libs/ # Prebuilt DexKit native/runtime JARs (see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md) ├── LICENSES/ # Full LGPL-3.0, GPL-3.0 & Apache-2.0 texts for libs/ └── tests/ # Automated host unit test suite (run_host_tests.py) ``` --- ## Feedback, Bug Reports & Support Because **v2.0.0** is an early adaptive release tested primarily on ported firmwares, diagnostics logs from other Galaxy models and stock builds help shape future updates! Reach out anytime: - **Telegram:** [@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97) *(recommended — include **Copy Diagnostics** from the app if reporting a bug)* - **GitHub Issues:** [Report a bug or request a feature](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/issues) --- ## License & Author - **Module Source Code:** Distributed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). - **Third-Party Libraries (`libs/`):** Includes prebuilt native **DexKit Core (`libdexkit.so`)** licensed under **GNU LGPL v3.0**, alongside **DexKit API (`dexkit.jar`)**, **FlatBuffers Java**, and **Kotlin Standard Library** under **Apache License 2.0**. Full attribution, upstream source links, SHA-256 checksums, and license texts are documented in **[THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md)**. - **Author:** Developed by **tavataan** (Telegram: [@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)).

# 现在栏颜色 **在 Samsung One UI 8.0、8.5 和 9.0+ 上原生自定义折叠的 Now Bar 胶囊背景（锁定屏幕和 AOD）** [![一个 UI](https://img.shields.io/badge/One_UI-8.0_%7C_8.5_%7C_9.0+-0072DE?style=flat-square&logo=samsung&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases) [![框架](https://img.shields.io/badge/Framework-LSPosed_%7C_Vector-EC407A?style=flat-square)](https://modules.lsfused.org/module/io.github.tavataan.nowbarcolor) [![发布](https://img.shields.io/badge/Release-v2.0.0-2EA043?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/latest) [![语言](https://img.shields.io/badge/I18n-EN_%7C_ES_%7C_PT-8A2BE2?style=flat-square)](#features) [![许可证：MIT + 第三方](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT_%7C_LGPL--3.0_%7C_Apache--2.0-F1E05A?style=flat-square)](#license--author) --- ## 概述 **Now Bar Color** 是一种自适应 Xposed/LSPosed 模块，适用于运行 **One UI 8.0、8.5 和 One UI 9.0+** 的已 root 三星 Galaxy 设备。从 **v2.0.0** 开始，它作为带有独立版本适配器的**单个通用 APK 提供，由设备上 **DexKit** 字节码扫描提供支持 - 针对您安装的“SystemUI”和“AOD_Service”动态操作，无需单独的“AOD_Service” APK 或根 Suite ZIP。 它使您可以完全控制折叠的锁定屏幕和始终显示 (AOD) Now Bar 胶囊背景 — 纯色、校准的 One UI 8.5 风格玻璃**颜色模糊**、平滑的两级水平渐变和壁纸自适应调色板 — 同时保持专辑封面、图标、操作按钮、文本易读性和本机动画完好无损。 它还包括一个原生 One UI 配套应用程序，具有交互式实时胶囊预览阶段、实时动画音频波形、带有实时颜色剪切的方圆矢量徽章、按类别切换、独立的不透明度和模糊/色调滑块、内置兼容性诊断以及**英语、西班牙语和葡萄牙语**本地化。 > [!注意] > **早期项目通知、测试设备和主动更新** > > 该项目仍然**非常新且得到积极维护**，因此在未经测试的 Galaxy 型号或“AOD_Service”版本上仍然可能会出现视觉故障或特定于固件的错误。未来的更新将继续扩大固件覆盖范围。 > > **v2.0.0 仅在以下自定义 ROM / 端口环境中直接测试** *（移植的固件通常嵌入较新 Galaxy 旗舰机的“AOD_Service” APK，因此即使 DexKit 动态解析，未经测试的工厂库存版本也可能会有所不同）*： > > |设备|环境和一个 UI |已验证“AOD_Service”构建（“versionCode”）|适配器| > | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | > | **Galaxy S23 Ultra** | **自定义 ROM / 端口 (`SM-S938B`)** — One UI 9.0 (Android 17) | `8.9.65.90` (`896590000`) & `8.9.67.3` (`896703000`) | `OneUi9Adapter` | > | **Galaxy S20 FE (`SM-G780G`)** | **自定义 ROM / 端口** — 一个 UI 8.5 (Android 16) | `8.9.32.89` (`893289000`) | `OneUi85Adapter` | > | **Galaxy S22 Ultra** | **自定义 ROM / 端口 (`SM-S901E`)** — One UI 8.0 (Android 16) | `8.9.15.39` (`891539000`) | `OneUi80Adapter` | > > 如果您在另一个库存 ROM 或端口上遇到缺少控件、恢复颜色或未映射的诊断，请通过 Telegram **[@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)** 联系（使用应用程序内的 **复制诊断**）或在 GitHub 上提出问题！ --- ## 屏幕截图和示例 锁屏和 AOD 胶囊拼贴画显示 Now Brief、Music Media、Flashlight 和 Samsung Health 胶囊中的自定义纯色、两级渐变和半透明模糊*（从“v1.x”捕获；更新的屏幕截图将突出显示“v2.0.0”配套 UI 和镜面模糊边缘，稍后将添加）*： |媒体和现在简短的渐变|手电筒、健康和媒体模糊|红色渐变、深色药丸和半透明模糊| | :---: | :---: | :---: | | <我mg src="docs/screenshots/example1.png" width="260" alt="Now 媒体和简短渐变示例" /> | | | --- ## 兼容性和下载 (`v2.0.0`) **v2.0.0 使用单个通用 APK (`NowBarColor.apk`)** 跨兼容的 **一个 UI 8.0、8.5 和 9.0+** ROM (`arm64-v8a`) 运行，包括工厂固件和自定义 ROM 端口： - **不需要单独的 `AOD_Service` APK：** `AodScanner` 通过 **DexKit** 检查您安装的 `com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`，缓存每个构建的 `HookMap`，并自动为您的 One UI 一代选择独立的适配器（`OneUi80Adapter`、`OneUi85Adapter` 或 `OneUi9Adapter`）。 - **“v2.0.0+”不需要或建议使用根套件 ZIP：**不要**在一个 UI 8.0 / 8.5 / 9.0+ 设置上刷新旧版“v1.x”根 ZIP -“v2.0.0”仅通过 LSPosed/Vector 本地运行。 *（旧版“v1.3.0”工件严格保留在 [`4-1.3.0`](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/tag/4-1.3.0) 版本内存档。）* |渠道/目标|文件/目录条目|描述 |链接 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **GitHub 版本 (`5-2.0.0`)** | `NowBarColor.apk` |通用自适应模块 APK（`v2.0.0`，`versionCode 5`）| [下载APK (v2.0.0)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/5-2.0.0/NowBarColor.apk) | | **LSPosed 和矢量存储库** | `io.github.tavataan.nowbarcolor` |官方在线存储库列表和经理内部更新| [在 LSPosed / Vector Repo 中查看](https://modules.lsspoke.org/module/io.github.tavataan.nowbarcolor) | <详情> 从 v1.x 升级（从 NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip 迁移或替换 AOD_Service.apk）
如果您之前安装了 **`v1.2.0`** 或 **`v1.3.0`**，请在保留 `v2.0.0+` 之前删除旧的系统/端口覆盖，以便您的设备不再携带不必要的 `priv-app` 安装或过时的挂钩： 1. **更新模块 APK：** 在 `v1.3.0` 上安装 [`NowBarColor.apk` (`v2.0.0`)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/5-2.0.0/NowBarColor.apk)（两个版本共享相同的签名证书）。 2. **如果您刷写了`NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip`（One UI 8.0 / 8.5）：** - 打开 **KernelSU**、**Magisk** 或 **APatch Manager** → **模块**。 - 禁用或删除 **`NowBar_LockScreen_Suite`** 和 **`LockScreenFix_OU9`**。 - 干净地重新启动您的设备。 3. **如果您在 One UI 9.0+ 上手动安装了“v1.x”独立“AOD_Service.apk”：** - *（可选，恢复 ROM 的工厂 `AOD_Service`）* 在 root shell 中运行： ````bash su -c“pm 卸载系统更新 com.samsung.android.app.aodservice” ```` - 打开 **Now Bar Color** 一次，以便 DexKit 扫描恢复的工厂“AOD_Service”版本，然后重新启动。 --- ## 安装指南 1. 确保在运行 **One UI 8.0、8.5 或 9.0+** 的已 root 三星 Galaxy 设备上安装 **LSPosed**（或 **Vector** / JingMatrix fork）并处于活动状态。 2. 从 GitHub Releases 或 **LSPosed / Vector Repository** 下载并安装 [`NowBarColor.apk` (v2.0.0)](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/releases/download/5-2.0.0/NowBarColor.apk)。 3. 打开 **LSPosed Manager**（或 **Vector Manager**），启用 **Now Bar Color**，并确保选中其推荐范围： - **`系统 UI`** (`com.android.systemui`) - **`始终显示`** (`com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`) 4. 打开 **Now Bar Color** 一次，以便 DexKit 扫描并缓存您的 `AOD_Service` 版本的 `HookMap`，然后 **重新启动您的设备** *（推荐）* 或运行下面的双进程重启： ````bash su -c“pkill -f com.android.systemui；pkill -f com.samsung.android.app.aodservice” ```` 5. *（Galaxy Store 更新注意事项）* 如果三星更新 **始终显示** (`AOD_Service`) 稍后，打开 **Now Bar Color**（或点击诊断内的 **重新扫描**；`NowBarConfigProvider` 还会根据需要检测不匹配的 `versionCode`/时间戳）并重新启动系统 UI / AOD 或重新启动。 --- ## 故障排除 - **应用程序报告模块处于非活动状态（`模块活动（LSPosed）： false`）：** 确认 **现在条形颜色** 在 LSPosed / 矢量管理器中打开，验证 **`com.android.systemui`** 和 **`com.samsung.android.app.aodservice`** 在模块范围中检查，并执行完全重新启动。 - **诊断显示 `MISSING(...)` 或 `AMBIGUOUS(...)` 插槽：** 打开应用程序的 **诊断** 对话框并点击 **重新扫描**。如果插槽仍未映射（或显示 *部分兼容性*），请点击 **复制诊断** 并将完整报告以及您的设备型号和 ROM 详细信息发送到 Telegram **[@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97)** 或 GitHub 问题。 - **三星始终显示更新后胶囊颜色消失：** 缓存的“HookMap”条目绑定到之前的“AOD_Service”“versionCode”和“lastUpdateTime”。打开 **Now Bar Color**（或在诊断中按 **Re-scan**），以便 DexKit 索引新 APK，然后运行 ​​`su -c "p​​kill -f com.android.systemui; pkill -f com.samsung.android.app.aodservice"` 或重新启动。 - **从“v1.x”更新后出现故障或重复卡：** 确保旧版“NowBar_LockScreen_Suite”和“LockScreenFix_OU9”模块已禁用/卸载并重新启动（请参阅上面的“从 v1.x 升级**”）。 --- ## 特点 ### 视觉效果模式和自适应调色板 |完成模式 |自适应壁纸提取| | :--- | :--- | | **纯纯色：** 清晰、高对比度的实心胶囊背景，具有每个类别的不透明度。 | **底部区域：** 对“立即栏”后面的确切下部锁定屏幕壁纸区域进行采样。 | | **两级水平渐变：**全局或每个胶囊平滑的自定义或预设双色渐变。 | **莫奈口音：** 拉动三星的动态 Material You 系统口音调色板。 | | **一个 ​​UI 8.5 玻璃颜色模糊：** 校准 `16px–100px` 磨砂模糊（默认 `~60%` / `~65px`）、专用 **色调不透明度** 滑块（`25%–85%`，默认 `~60%`）、饱和 `SemBlurInfo` ColorCurve 渲染，以及实时预览阶段镜像的微妙 `~1dp` 对角镜面玻璃边缘 + 表面光泽。 | **主背景：** 与主锁屏壁纸色调相匹配。 | ### 使用动态矢量徽章进行精细的按类别控制 每个 **10 Now Bar 胶囊类别** 都包含一个大型 One UI 方圆徽章，带有由其活动颜色或渐变动态支持的透明矢量切口，以及独立的切换、颜色覆盖和不透明度滑块： |类别 |目标组件/范围| | :--- | :--- | | **1.音乐和媒体播放** | `NowBarMediaCardView` | | **2.时钟、计时器和秒表** |标准和持续时钟胶囊 | | **3.录音机和音频备忘录** |有源录音芯片| | **4.手电筒** |快速切换活性胶囊 | | **5.电池供电和充电** | `NowBarBatteryCardView` | | **6。现在简要/Galaxy AI 建议** | `NowBarBriefCardView` | | **7.持续的电话** |活动呼叫状态胶囊 | | **8.模式和例程** |主动 Bixby/系统模式 | | **9.体育、地图和三星健康** |导航、实时比分和锻炼 | | **10.其他现场活动** |口译员、Smart View 和第三方正在进行的芯片 | ### 底层架构和配套应用程序 - **1 APK + 独立的一个 UI 适配器：** `AodScanner` 使用本机 **DexKit** 来解析首次运行时混淆的 `AOD_Service` / `FaceWidget` 类、方法和字段，通过 `NowBarConfigProvider` 持久保存架构版本的 `HookMap`，并通过 `NowBarAdapterFactory`（`OneUi80Adapter`、`OneUi85Adapter`、`OneUi9Adapter`）干净地分派。 - **零延迟 Frame-0 样式和唤醒稳定性：** 拦截 `NowBarCardStackView` 内的卡片创建，抑制三星的本机 `NowBarCardGradientView` 芯片覆盖，保持控件在 One UI 8.5 前台状态下可见，并保留自定义One UI 8.0 展开/折叠和唤醒/解锁转换期间的颜色。 - **原生 One UI 配套应用程序：** 交互式“CapsulePreviewStage”复制真实壁纸模糊 + 玻璃光泽、动画“OneUIMediaCapsuleView”波形、“OneUIFloatingBar”导航、“HsvColorPickerView”、内置诊断导出以及 **EN / ES / PT** 语言切换器。 --- ## 从源代码构建 该存储库包含一个与 Linux、Android (**Termux**) 和桌面环境兼容的独立 Python 构建脚本 (`build.py`)。 ### 构建要求 - **JDK 8+**（`javac`、`keytool`） - **Android SDK 平台 `android-34+`** (`--android-jar` 或 `ANDROID_HOME` / `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`) - **推荐 Android SDK 构建工具 `35.0.0+`** *（Android 15+/16+ 上 `libdexkit.so` 的 `zipalign -P 16` 16 KB ELF 页面对齐需要；`build.py` 在 `34.0.0` 上自动回落到 `-p` 4 KB 对齐）* ### 编译并签名 ````bash # 1.克隆存储库 git 克隆 https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color.git cd OneUI-Now-Bar-Color # 2. 运行主机验证测试（可选） python3测试/run_host_tests.py --android-jar # 3. 构建并签署 APK（如果不存在，则自动生成 build/debug.keystore） python3 构建.py ```` #### 密钥库和签名再现性 - **默认调试签名：** 当省略 `--keystore` 时，`build.py` 自动创建（如果不存在）并在 `build/debug.keystore` 重用本地密钥库（`--alias androiddebugkey`，默认密码 `android`）。 - **自定义签名：** 通过标志和环境变量提供您自己的密钥库： ````bash 导出NOWBAR_STORE_PASS =“您的商店密码” 导出NOWBAR_KEY_PASS =“您的密钥密码” python3 build.py --keystore /path/to/release.keystore --alias mykey ```` - **存储库卫生：** `build/`、`*.keystore` 和 `*.jks` 在 [`.gitignore`](.gitignore) 中被忽略； **Git 存储库中不存储私有发布密钥库**。 签名的 APK 输出到： ````文本 构建/NowBarColor.apk ```` --- ## 项目结构 ````文本 ├── AndroidManifest.xml & build.py # 包清单、提供程序、构建和 APK 签名管道 ├── meta_xposed/ & SCOPE & SUMMARY # Xposed/LSPosed & Vector 目录元数据 ├── asset/ & res/ # xposed_init，预览图，矢量图标和本地化字符串 ├── src/.../nowbarcolor/ │ ├── MainActivity.java & ui/ # 配套 UI、CapsulePreviewStage、FloatingBar & I18n │ ├── NowBarHook.java & 适配器 # 多层Xposed钩子和OneUi80/85/9隔离适配器 │ ├── AodScanner & HookMap # 设备上的 DexKit 字节码扫描器、缓存和 ConfigProvider │ └── CapsuleStyle & BlurSpec # 纯色、渐变和校准的 16–100px 颜色模糊管道 ├── libs/ # 预构建的 DexKit 本机/运行时 JAR（请参阅 THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md） ├── LICENSES/ # libs/ 的完整 LGPL-3.0、GPL-3.0 和 Apache-2.0 文本 └──tests/ # 自动化主机单元测试套件（run_host_tests.py） ```` --- ## 反馈、错误报告和支持 由于 **v2.0.0** 是一个早期自适应版本，主要在移植的固件上进行测试，因此来自其他 Galaxy 型号和库存版本的诊断日志有助于塑造未来的更新！随时联系： - **Telegram：** [@Tava_Mon97](https://t.me/Tava_Mon97) *（推荐 — 如果报告错误，请包括从应用程序中复制诊断信息）* - **GitHub 问题：** [报告错误或请求功能](https://github.com/TAVATAAN/OneUI-Now-Bar-Color/issues) --- ## 许可证和作者 - **模块源代码：** 根据 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE) 分发。 - **第三方库 (`libs/`)：** 包括根据 **GNU LGPL v3.0** 许可的预构建本机 **DexKit Core (`libdexkit.so`)**，以及 **DexKit API (`dexkit.jar`)**、**FlatBuffers Java** 和 **Kotlin 标准库**，根据 **Apache License 2.0** 进行许可。完整归属、上游源链接、SHA-256 校验和以及许可证文本记录在 **[THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md）**。 -
